roundup.text:
Can AI run a business for 90 days without losing the plot?

SN15 ORO’s new SMB Bench puts agents at a simulated produce-buying desk. Eight of nine tested models finish below a simple fixed buying rule on average. ORO published the run traces, and I reproduced the headline averages from its scored data.

Also in today’s Bittensor report:
• SN107 Minos opens its Mac beta, with rewards still off.
• SN23 Trishool names SN92 REAX as its EU Mode model supplier.
• SN46 Instant’s two finalized burns total 1,199.028674159 alpha.

The November 7 edition and my latest public video are on my site.

https://shizzyunchained.com/subnet-news/2026-11-07
